description:
About Us
At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.
Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.
We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.
At Medius,
our values guide how we work and grow together:
Connect
– We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.
Question
– We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.
Own
– We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.
At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.
Lear more at www.medius.com
Job overview
You’re perfect for this role if you:
Are passionate about coding and curious about how AI can transform the way people work.
Enjoy experimenting, prototyping, and learning fast in an agile environment.
Want to grow your skills by contributing to the development of AI agents, chatbots, and internal productivity tools.
Are comfortable working with both technical concepts (APIs, databases, LLMs) and user-facing features.
Are eager to learn from senior engineers, a Tech Lead, and Data Scientists, while also contributing with your own ideas.
Responsibilities and Duties
Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of AI-powered solutions (chatbots, agents, integrations).
Implement features under the guidance of senior developers and the Tech Lead.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following established coding standards.
Work with APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure, Salesforce, SharePoint) to integrate external data into solutions.
Support prototyping and experimentation with new AI technologies, frameworks, and models.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure solution reliability.
Collaborate with Product Owner and team members to translate user stories into technical tasks.
Document solutions and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
Success Criteria / KPIs
1. Code Quality & Learning
90% of contributions pass code review with minimal rework.
Demonstrated improvement in coding practices and architecture understanding after 6–12 months.
Active participation in code reviews and technical discussions.
2. Delivery &
Reliability
Consistently delivers tasks on time and within scope.
Number of bugs or incidents traced back to code is minimized (<5% of tasks delivered).
Successful implementation of at least
X new features or enhancements per quarter
.

Growth
Positive feedback from Tech Lead and team on collaboration and learning progress.
Increasing autonomy over time (less guidance needed for recurring tasks).
Active contributions to team knowledge base (documentation, demos, lessons learned).
4. Innovation & Impact
Participation in prototyping and testing new AI features.
At least one initiative or idea per quarter suggested to improve solutions or workflows.

resumes in French will be automatically rejected).

Parce que nous sommes indépendants, fiables, accessibles et engagés, parce que nos équipes sont soudées, à l'écoute, attentionnées et passionnées, parce que nos experts sont à la fois des partenaires spécialisés et attentifs, nous nous surpassons pour créer des solutions globales de leadership.

Contexte du poste
Dans le cadre de sa croissance,
Linedata
, éditeur de référence dans le domaine de l’Asset Management et les crédits & Financement destinés aux
institutions financières
, recherche un
Data Scientist / ML Engineer
passionné par la donnée et l’intelligence artificielle.
Vous intégrerez une équipe déjà en place, qui collabore avec les experts métiers et les équipes de développement, pour concevoir, mettre en œuvre et industrialiser des modèles analytiques au service de la performance et de la prise de décision.
Job Requirement
Missions principales
Concevoir, développer et déployer des modèles de machine learning et d’IA générative répondant aux besoins des métiers financiers ;
Analyser et valoriser les données internes et externes afin de générer des insights exploitables ;
Participer à la constitution et à la structuration des data pipelines en collaboration avec les Data Engineers ;
Contribuer à la mise en place de solutions d’industrialisation et de monitoring des modèles ;
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et les experts métiers pour traduire les besoins fonctionnels en solutions data ;
Réaliser des études exploratoires, prototypes et POC pour valider les approches analytiques ;
Assurer une veille technologique sur les nouvelles méthodes et outils d’analyse de données.
Compétences techniques requises
Maîtrise des langages de programmation Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) ;
Solide compréhension des techniques de machine learning, deep learning et statistiques appliquées ;
Bonne connaissance des bases de données SQL / NoSQL et des environnements cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) ;
La connaissance d’outils de data visualisation (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, etc.) est un plus ;
Connaissance des bonnes pratiques d’industrialisation (Git, CI/CD, APIs, Docker, etc.) ;
La connaissance du domaine financier (marchés, risques, conformité, asset management, etc.) est un atout majeur.
Profil recherché
Diplôme d’ingénieur ou Master (Bac+5) en data science, mathématiques appliquées, informatique, statistiques ou équivalent ;
Expérience de 2 à 5 ans minimum dans un poste similaire (une première expérience dans le secteur financier est un plus) ;
Bonne maîtrise des modèles NLP / IA générative open source (manage services et déploiement local) ;
Solides capacités analytiques et rigueur scientifique ;
Esprit d’équipe, sens du service et excellente communication ;
Curiosité technologique et envie de travailler dans un environnement innovant et collaboratif.
Engagement Pour La Diversité
Nous reconnaissons, célébrons et cherchons à accroître la diversité dans notre organisation. La diversité est un atout pour les organisations et est liée à une meilleure performance. Elle fait partie intégrante de notre façon de travailler et est impérative pour notre succès. About Us
At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.
Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.
We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.
At Medius,
our values guide how we work and grow together:
Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.
Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.
Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.
At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.
Lear more at www.medius.com
Job Overview
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our R&D team. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about delivering high-quality, end-to-end business applications into production. You will contribute to a collaborative engineering environment where your ideas are embraced and nurtured, helping shape robust, scalable solutions in an ever-evolving business context.
Responsibilities And Duties
Contribute to Medius’s codebase as a Senior Full Stack Developer.
Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-quality features and solutions.
Identify, discuss, document, and communicate technical improvements within your area of responsibility.
Provide technical leadership across projects, features, service fundamentals, and tools.
Mentor new and junior engineers to accelerate their growth and integration into the development environment.
Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Qualifications
Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
4+ years of software development experience using C#, .NET, and .NET Core.
Strong backend development experience, including RESTful APIs, API design, SQL, and databases.
Deep knowledge of frontend technologies such as TypeScript, Angular, React, or Flutter.
Experience in agile development environments using continuous deployment and delivery (Git, CI/CD).
Ability to architect and design modular, scalable systems (microservices, event-driven architectures, resilience patterns).
High standards for UI quality and experience implementing outcomes from UX research and product design.
Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking).
Please send your resume in English (
resumes in French will be automatically rejected).

title: 1 - Specialist Technologist Tooling Preparation
description:
LEONI is a global provider of products, solutions, and services for energy and data management in the automotive industry. With around 87,000 employees in 21 countries and EUR 5 billion in sales in 2024, we are a leading supplier of complex wiring systems and customer‑specific cable harnesses.
We believe that meaningful connections drive innovation and success. At LEONI, you will join a diverse, international, and collaborative team shaping the future of mobility, from autonomous driving to alternative drives and smart charging solutions.
Since mid‑2025, we have been part of the Luxshare Group, one of the world’s leading solution providers for consumer electronics, communications and data centers, automotive, and medical industries, based in China. Join us and help shape the future of connectivity together.
Job Description
Manages the ordering and release of the rework tool, handy tool, clip gun, etc. during product changes and new introduction (Change Management & Project Management)
Acts as the interface between production engineer and supplier for any new designed tool
Installs and supports in releases of process for foaming tool, moulding tool and all other innovated tooling (application of robot, AGV, VR glass, etc.)
Creates Maintenance Working instractions for all kinds of tools and makes sure Maintenance team is trained and coached
Performs activities in order to establish setup parameters and keep figures into system for necessary tools
Manufactures and/or coordinates service provider to delivery auxiliary tools and fixtures as well as non-standard equipment
Performs specific activities for construction and modification of assembly facilities according to requirements (standards) during product changes and new introduction (Change Management & Project Management) according to the process flow and plan
Defines and setups the spare parts database with all required information and orders initial spare parts
Implements lessons learned, best practice and actively shares the information within the Production Management network and country plants
Creates and reviews Tooling preparation local work instruction and training for Production Maintenance team regarding tools
Monitors the traceability of ordered tools, the material status needed for material configuration tests and validation
Ensures support for the execution of technical changes based on drawing requirement, QM requirement etc.
Qualifications
Level of Education : University Degree
Branch of study : Electrical - Mechanical - Mechatronics or similar
Experience : 2 years in the automotive industry are appreciated
IT: Microsoft Office
Social competences: Communication /Social & intercultural sensitivity / Change management /Target & result-orientation/ Motivation & resilience /Self-organization /Conflict management / Teamwork
Professional competences: Equipment Maintenance /Preventative and Predictive Maintenance /Equipment Repair /Machine Operations /Machine Tools/Maintenance of electrical control panels and/or preparation

People of all genders are always meant equally; for linguistic simplification and better readability, only the masculine form is used in the text.

title: Scientist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Science Engineer to join Infor Decision Analytics and Science (IDeAS), a division of Infor that delivers AI/ML solutions across industries. The role is responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing large-scale predictive and prescriptive analytics that drive measurable business impact for customers. Data Science Engineers at IDeAS combine analytics expertise and technical depth to transform data into actionable solutions, enabling fast and effective decision automation for business functions.
Key Responsibilities:
Machine learning solution development
*
Design, build, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, including model orchestration and data pipelines.
*
Design and implement ETL/ELT processes from customer data sources to support ML solution requirements.
*
Perform and review exploratory data analysis on large and complex datasets to assess quality, extract insights, and guide modeling.
*
Design and build innovative, pragmatic AI/ML solutions leveraging the latest technologies across industries.
Business collaboration and leadership
*
Lead discussions with business stakeholders to identify challenges that can be addressed with AI/ML.
*
Communicate analytical results and implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*
Review and provide guidance on the work of junior team members within projects.
Communication and knowledge sharing
*
Share technical ideas and code effectively through blog posts, GitHub, or similar platforms.
*
Present complex technical topics in clear and actionable terms for audiences ranging from scientists and engineers to business leaders.
Basic Qualifications:
*
Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Mathematical Modeling, Operations Research, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical, Industrial, or a related quantitative field.
*
Extensive real-world experience designing and implementing full ML/optimization solution pipelines (ETL, preprocessing, data analysis, prototyping, deployment, and inference).
*
Proficient programming skills in Python and data-querying skills using SQL, PySpark, or similar technologies.
*
Strong data modeling and problem-solving skills.
*
Hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
*
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
*
Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills to solve complex business problems.
Preferred Qualifications:
*
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.
*
Experience in building time-series forecasting and recommendation models.
*
Experience with applied AI/ML solutions in demand forecasting, anomaly detection, pricing, or recommendations.

Identify strengths and weaknesses in sales execution and enable targeted coaching strategies.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data integrity and consistency.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field.
